description: This file defines a final class 'Middleware' in the GuzzleHttp namespace. It contains static methods to create various middleware functions for HTTP requests, such as cookies handling, error handling, request history tracking, request/response logging, redirects, retries, and request/response mapping. These middleware functions are designed to be used in an HTTP client middleware stack to modify or inspect requests and responses.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A collection of static methods to create HTTP middleware functions for handling cookies, errors, history, redirects, retries, logging, and request/response transformation in Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware to handle cookies by attaching a CookieJarInterface to requests and extracting cookies from responses.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware to throw exceptions for HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is enabled.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware to record request and response data into a provided container (array or ArrayAccess).

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes optional callback functions before and after sending a request, without modifying the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware to handle HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that retries requests based on a user-defined decider function, with optional delay logic.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware to log requests and responses using a PSR logger and formatter.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware to set default headers such as content-type, content-length, transfer-encoding, and expect headers.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware to transform requests via a user-provided mapping function.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware to transform responses via a user-provided mapping function.
